# Code Discovery Skill

Use this skill to build a stable map of the legacy application.

## Procedure

1. Enumerate source and configuration files.
2. Identify symbols and entry points.
3. Identify calls and dependencies.
4. Identify data access and external integrations.
5. Identify tests.
6. Capture source locations.
7. Record unsupported or ambiguous constructs.

Prefer deterministic analysis tools when available. Use LLM reasoning only to interpret structured observations.
